title: Famous sculptors and the country they were born in

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { ?item wdt:P106 wd:Q1281618 . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 30) ?item wdt:P19 ?pl . ?pl wdt:P17 ?c . } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) = 1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 199

country.pick: Which country was sculptor {label} born in?
country.match: Match each sculptor to the country where they were born.
country.odd: Three of these sculptors were born in {value}. Which one wasn't?

rows.label: Yayoi Kusama
rows.hook: is famous for polka dots, giant pumpkins and mirrored infinity rooms

rows.label: Michelangelo
rows.hook: carved the marble David and painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling

rows.label: Anish Kapoor
rows.hook: made the giant mirrored bean sculpture in Chicago's Millennium Park

rows.label: Auguste Rodin
rows.hook: sculpted The Thinker and The Kiss

rows.label: Jeff Koons
rows.hook: makes giant shiny balloon-animal sculptures and a huge flower-covered puppy

rows.label: Damien Hirst
rows.hook: displayed a shark preserved in a glass tank of formaldehyde

rows.label: Gian Lorenzo Bernini
rows.hook: was the Baroque master who carved Apollo and Daphne and designed the colonnade of St. Peter's Square

rows.label: Donatello
rows.hook: cast the Gattamelata, one of the first life-size bronze horse-and-rider statues of the Renaissance

rows.label: Henry Moore
rows.hook: is known for large smooth reclining figures with holes through them

rows.label: Alexander Calder
rows.hook: invented the hanging mobile, a kinetic sculpture that moves with the air

rows.label: Alberto Giacometti
rows.hook: is famous for extremely thin, elongated walking figures
